messages:
olivia: Quick check — quantized bring-up for ranker-v3 shows ~12% throughput improvement but NDCG@10 drops ~0.8 pts on our dev cohort. Anyone seen this pattern tied to preprocessing/tokenization changes?

sam: Hmm — did you change doc truncation or candidate normalization? small tweaks there can flip NDCG.

olivia: I toggled aggressive truncation (cut to 512 from 1024) and enabled the subword-normalization script. Model binary is q4_psi-packed, nothing else touched.

kai: Try a parity run with the float baseline's exact preprocessing. Tokenizer mismatch is an easy silent diff when switching quant pipelines.

raj: Also confirm priming/prompt tokens are identical. PTQ sometimes amplifies prefix sensitivity, especially with short queries.

anya: Can you paste the eval command you used?

olivia: Sure — running with the harness:
```
eval-harness \  --model ranker-v3-q4 \  --preproc "config=agg_trunc512,norm=subword" \  --metric "ndcg@10,mrr" \  --cohort devset_v2 \  --jobs 16
```

ml-eval-bot: eval job 1788884321-1 finished — ndcg@10=0.842 (baseline float 0.850), mrr=0.621, p95 latency -18% vs baseline.

sam: 0.842 vs 0.850 is small but consistent. Do a slice breakdown: short queries vs long docs.

kai: PTQ often hits long-doc scenarios harder. Run slices: `short_query_len<=10` and `long_doc_len>2000`.

olivia: Running slices now. Also going to re-run with truncation=1024 and disable subword norm to isolate.

ml-eval-bot: eval job 1788884321-2 finished — slice deltas: short_query ndcg delta -0.01, long_doc ndcg delta -0.07 (q4 vs float, same preproc).

raj: Looks like long docs are losing most signal. Could be kv-cache packing or an attention kernel edge for longer sequences in quant path. Does the q4 kernel support >1024 attention segments without fallback?

anya: The config I saw had `kvpack=true`. That could change how segments are batched.

olivia: Confirmed kvpack=true. I'll re-run with kvpack=false to isolate.

sam: Also run a float run with the current preprocessing to separate quant effect from preproc effect.

olivia: Plan: 1) float baseline with current preproc, 2) q4 with trunc=1024 & kvpack=false, 3) q4 with tokenization parity script from baseline. Collect NDCG/MRR + latency p50/p95. I'll own the runs and post results here.

kai: ACK. Recommend also a small canary A/B (prod-mock) to sanity-check user-facing signal before any rollout.

olivia: Thanks — will update when runs complete :pray:
